messages:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Multiple GPU nodes in prod-infer showing incremental OOMs and container restarts across pool A. Auto-escalation to oncall. Examples in last 30m: cuMemAlloc failed (out of memory), launcher crashloop, pod OOMKilled.
Sam (oncall): ack. I'm looking at node pool A-1 first. pulling logs.
Anya (infra): seeing steady growth in resident GPU memory for rvw-runtime on those nodes; KV cache resident pages rising ~30MB/min. Not a spike — slow creep.
Ravi (runtime): that pattern smells like slab fragmentation + stale KV pages not being evicted. Could be a race in the paged-attn allocator freeing path.
Lee (sre): any customer impact yet? SupportBot, any open complains?
SupportBot: Two customers reported higher latencies for embeddings and a few 502s in the last 40m. No paging outages yet; degraded throughput for heavy long-context requests.
Sam (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle longest sequences, 2) enable emergency kv-compact on affected nodes, 3) perform rolling restart with restart policy to avoid simultaneous restarts. Any objections?
Ravi (runtime): agree. I'd also pin a fallback model variant with lower KV footprint for the canary route. Doable via route flag.
Anya (infra): running kv compaction now on node a1-03 and a1-05. Command: ```ssh ops@a1-03 'sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv_compact --max-slots=0.8'```
Sam (oncall): executing throttle: updated route config to cap max_sequence=2048 for /v1/chat on hostpool-a. CLI: ```redwoodctl routes update --pool hostpool-a --param max_sequence=2048```
Lee (sre): I'm bumping node eviction aggressiveness: ```kubectl -n inference patch ds rvw-runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"rvw-runtime","env":[{"name":"KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD","value":"0.55"}]}]}}}}'```
Ravi (runtime): logs from a1-03: ```E 17:12:03 runtime kv_cache.cpp:421 free_miss race detected; slab_count mismatch; retaining stale page; cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (1)```
Sam (oncall): good catch. That free_miss race matches fragmentation reports. I'll open a quick ticket and mark it P1.
Anya (infra): compaction completed on a1-03: reclaimed ~1.1GB. Node memory stabilized for ~8m then started drifting again.
Ravi (runtime): that implies continuous slow leak not fixed by one-off compaction. We need to enable periodic compaction and a temporary guardrail: restart container once resident > 90% for >5m.
Sam (oncall): implementing container restart guard. Patch applied to daemonset to auto-restart using liveness hook script that triggers when /proc/gpu_mem > threshold.
Lee (sre): rolling restart queued with maxUnavailable=1. We'll roll over a1 nodes only. Noting customers on hostpool-a for support.
SupportBot: Notifying tier-2 support and affected customers: "We are aware of degraded performance for long-context workloads; mitigation in progress."
Ravi (runtime): I'm deploying a canary route pointing 10% traffic to model-quantized-small (lower KV footprint). Command: ```redwoodctl route set-canary --route /v1/generate --variant model-q-small --percent 10```
Anya (infra): monitoring CUDA errors stream; still seeing occasional cuBLAS init errors on a1-07. Node shows high fragmentation and some kernel retries. Considering cordon a1-07 after next pod drains.
Sam (oncall): cordon a1-07 now to stop new pods: ```kubectl cordon a1-07``` Draining in 2m with graceful termination=120s.
Lee (sre): after drain, moving pods to hostpool-b nodes. We'll watch latency delta.
Ravi (runtime): adding runtime debug hooks for slab allocator: enable env KV_SLAB_DEBUG=1 for canary only. Will collect stack traces for free path.
Anya (infra): set up periodic kv_compact cron every 10m for hostpool-a as emergency measure. Not ideal long-term but reduces immediate drift.
Sam (oncall): timeline/notes: initial detection 17:05, compaction started 17:12, rolling restart in progress 17:25, cordon a1-07 17:32, canary traffic change 17:38.
SupportBot: Status update sent to customers at 17:40: "Engineering investigating memory fragmentation causing OOMs; mitigations deployed — canary and restarts; we will update within 30m."
Ravi (runtime): next steps: 1) reproduce slab-free race locally with debug, 2) add atomic checks and a defensive free path, 3) longer-term: per-node KV defrag and slot compaction.
Lee (sre): postmortem checklist created. Adding runbook steps for emergency kv-compaction and cordon+drain.
Sam (oncall): handing to next oncall: @Anya take 01:00-04:00 window. I'll leave notes in the ticket. If drift resumes after compaction schedule removed, escalate to eng-runtime for hotfix.
Anya (infra): ack, taking handoff. I'll keep cron compaction in place for next 6h and collect metrics on leak rate.
Ravi (runtime): ack, will prioritize repro and patch. Adding a small regression test for slow resident growth.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. Tracking ticket: RW-INC-5990. Closing this thread for live triage but keeping it pinned to oncall channel. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident RW-INC-5990 created and linked to runbook kv-frag-emergency. Severity: P1."
